text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I fell completely short! To think the gap 
was this big... jeez...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ryan, Lady McQueen... We have long 
hoped that victory here would be claimed 
by the two of you, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, how terrible. No, even if we 
despair...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but I will seize 
glory next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Surely McQueen feels the exact same way! 
She will live up to everyone's 
expectations! And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro 
family! I'll make sure to show everyone 
that Mejiro Ryan is here too, right at the 
Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right!! That's right, isn't 
it, Ryan-sama! I will continue to support 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I was just being frustrated all this 
time... and wasn't paying attention to 
everyone else.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, Ryan-chan was listening to the 
fans' voices. And she immediately followed 
up...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...That is what an Umamusume who carries 
expectations looks like. The difference 
between me and Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've decided. In the Takarazuka Kinen, 
I'll...!
